items.claim: Rect pose `lerp` drops `transform`, so `lerp(a, b, 1)` isn't `b`
Polygon axes `to`/`write` emit more numbers than `count`, overrunning the next row
Polygon `lerp` and `axes` take commands and fill rule from one side, so `lerp(a, b, 1)` draws `a`'s shape
items.note: `lerp` now throws when the command streams differ. Fields that don't interpolate come from the nearer end, as corners already did. `axes.add` builds from the pose it is given.

items.claim: `rotatedRectCorners` and `rotatedRectContainsPoint` ignore `transform`, and a flipped box contains no point
`AUTO_POSE_DESCRIPTOR.axes` treats a `{kind:'rect'}` Path as a rotatable rect pose

items.note: `insetBox` stays the exact inverse, flip included.

items.claim: `AUTO_POSE_DESCRIPTOR.lerp` turns a Path-and-rect pair into a pose full of `NaN`
items.note: This needed a behavior call nobody had made: it now throws, the strict choice, recorded in `docs/unruled.md` under "Audit round forty-one (2026-11-19): core's geometry".
